method.purpose: Non-mutating French coverage evidence audit after educator repairs.
method.canonical_field_policy: Do not populate estimated_known_token_coverage from this audit alone.
why: LEXICAL_COVERAGE_POLICY distinguishes curriculum support from actual individual learner mastery.
READING_PASSAGE_STANDARD says stable curriculum knowledge normally requires at least six meaningful contacts and successful reinforcement evidence.
The static corpus records planned review opportunities but contains no per-learner retrieval-success telemetry or validated starting-vocabulary profile.
Therefore supported coverage and a six-contact curriculum proxy can be audited, but neither is proof of actual learner-known coverage.
method.nlp: Stanza French tokenize,pos,lemma; standard GitHub-hosted runner; deterministic diagnostic only.
method.six_contact_proxy: A target enters the prior-six-contact proxy only after >=6 declared/planned meaningful contacts before the passage. Question target references are retrieval opportunities, not assumed successes.
method.support_gate: Passage-type diagnostic based on uncontrolled unknown candidate rate; this is not educator release approval.

decision.reason: This run establishes support/chronology evidence but cannot infer actual learner mastery; unresolved token candidates and target chronology findings require adjudication before any coverage PASS.
next_actions: adjudicate uncontrolled unknown candidates, beginning with highest-frequency types and passages exceeding the diagnostic threshold
decide/document a pre-telemetry semantic contract for estimated_known_token_coverage or allow an explicit unavailable/null state
only then issue record-level coverage evidence and update quality.coverage_check where substantively justified
